note: Both sets cover the same core facts: the 3" ø openings, the 1/2" edge radius note, and the W10X15 sections for the floor beams at grids 2, 3, 4 and near grid 5, plus the W8X13 roof beam at grids 2-5. Set B additionally captures the W10X15 section for the Floor Beam @ Grid 5 (detail D5), which the page supports and Set A omits. Both sets leave out the W10X15 section for Floor Beam @ Grid 6 (A1) and the W8X13 section and ø 3" openings for Roof Beam @ Grid 6 & Near Grid 5 (C1), and both attach 'T.O. STEEL' as a condition to the W8X13 section although it is part of the detail title (elevation reference), not a condition on the section.
remarks: Both sets miss the section designations for details A1 (FLOOR BEAM @ GRID 6, W10X15) and C1 (ROOF BEAM @ GRID 6 & NEAR GRID 5, W8X13), and the ø 3" openings shown in details C1 and E6. 'T.O. STEEL' is part of the E6 detail title (top-of-steel elevation) and is not really a condition on the W8X13 section; both sets make this same questionable binding.
